data.one_liner: Classes and helpers for testing applications built with the Flame Engine.
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of useful helpers and utilities designed specifically for testing games and applications that use the Flame Engine. It is also used internally for testing parts of Flame itself.
use_when: You are writing unit or widget tests for a Flame game.
You need specialized utilities to test Flame components and games.
avoid_when: You are not using the Flame Engine in your application.
You only need standard Flutter widget testing without game engine features.
strengths: Tailored specifically for the Flame game engine ecosystem.
Helps simplify testing loops and component behaviors in Flame.
weaknesses: Strictly tied to the Flame engine; useless for non-Flame projects.
Documentation outside of the package description and repository is sparse.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to your pubspec.yaml file alongside flutter_test and flame.
